unit.why: A single anecdote, quoted from another book, about R. Avraham Abele of Drohobych: his attendant hides under his bed at night and sees him perform a pidyon with 160 copper coins.
unit.boundary_note: The closing words 'מענין פיקוח נפש' are a section heading that belongs to the next division.

stories.start_quote: ובס׳ ב"א (על ת"ז בהק') מהה״ק ר׳ אברהם
stories.summary_en: An attendant of the hidden tzaddik R. Avraham Abele of Drohobych hides under his bed to learn what he does at night with holy names; he sees him perform a pidyon with 160 copper coins, and the rebbe senses him, rebukes him in anger and throws the coins to the floor.

quotes: ובסוף ימיו גילה אותו הה״ק מלובלין
tags.why: He was a hidden tzaddik working as a children's teacher until the Seer of Lublin revealed him.

quotes: ועשה פדיון עם ק״ס מטבעות נחושת
tags.why: The central act witnessed is a pidyon performed with coins.

quotes: וכעס עליו ונטל את הק״ס מטבעות
tags.why: The rebbe is angry at the attendant who spied on him.

quotes: והרגיש רבו שאדם אחד שוכב תחת המטה
tags.why: The rebbe senses the hidden spy.

quotes: היה יודע שרבו עוסק בשמות הקדושים
tags.why: The rebbe's nightly practice with holy names is what motivates the spying.

quotes: והיה רוצה לידע מה רבו עוסק בלילה
tags.why: The attendant tries to uncover the rebbe's hidden nightly practice.

quotes: אחר חצות הלילה ראה שרבו קם מהמטה
tags.why: A midnight vigil of secret worship.
The story turns on the attendant's relationship to his master.

quotes: ובסוף ימיו גילה אותו הה״ק מלובלין
tags.why: His revelation is mentioned only in the frame; the plot is a secret glimpsed by a disciple.
Framed as an oral report from the old attendant R. Leib.
Takes place in the rebbe's home with his attendants.

missing_concepts: spying on a tzaddik's secret nightly practice
the symbolic number of coins in a pidyon (160)
